definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named solutionProgram proof term as the translated Python AST.
definitions.text:
rule solutionProgram =>
    Module(
      FuncDef("is_prime_from", Params("n", "divisor"),
        If(Compare(BinOp("*", Name("divisor"), Name("divisor")),
                   CmpOp(">", Name("n"))),
          Return(Bool(true)), .Stmts)
        If(Compare(BinOp("%", Name("n"), Name("divisor")),
                   CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
          Return(Bool(false)), .Stmts)
        Return(Call(Name("is_prime_from"), Name("n"),
                    BinOp("+", Name("divisor"), Int(1)))))
      FuncDef("is_prime", Params("n"),
        If(Compare(Name("n"), CmpOp("<", Int(2))),
          Return(Bool(false)), .Stmts)
        Return(Call(Name("is_prime_from"), Name("n"), Int(2))))
      FuncDef("choose_prime", Params("n", "best"),
        If(BoolOp("and",
             Call(Name("is_prime"), Name("n")),
             Compare(Name("n"), CmpOp(">", Name("best")))),
          Return(Name("n")), .Stmts)
        Return(Name("best")))
      FuncDef("largest_prime", Params("lst"),
        If(Compare(Call(Name("len"), Name("lst")), CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
          Return(Int(0)), .Stmts)
        Return(Call(Name("choose_prime"),
          Subscript(Name("lst"), Int(0)),
          Call(Name("largest_prime"),
            Subscript(Name("lst"), Slice(Int(1), NoBound, NoBound))))))
      FuncDef("digit_sum", Params("n"),
        If(Compare(Name("n"), CmpOp("<", Int(10))),
          Return(Name("n")), .Stmts)
        Return(BinOp("+", BinOp("%", Name("n"), Int(10)),
          Call(Name("digit_sum"), BinOp("//", Name("n"), Int(10))))))
      FuncDef("skjkasdkd", Params("lst"),
        Return(Call(Name("digit_sum"),
                    Call(Name("largest_prime"), Name("lst"))))))

definitions.rationale: Structural helper defining how programDefs extracts the function-definition map from a Module term.
Macro expansion defining the named solutionDefs proof term from solutionProgram.
Base equation defining refPrimeFrom to succeed once the candidate divisor squared exceeds the number.
definitions.text:
rule refPrimeFrom(N, D) => true
    requires D *Int D >Int N

definitions.rationale: Divisibility case defining refPrimeFrom to fail when the current candidate divides the number.
definitions.text:
rule refPrimeFrom(N, D) => false
    requires D *Int D <=Int N andBool N %Int D ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining refPrimeFrom by advancing to the next candidate divisor.
definitions.text:
rule refPrimeFrom(N, D) => refPrimeFrom(N, D +Int 1)
    requires D *Int D <=Int N andBool N %Int D =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Base case defining refPrime as false for integers below two.
Recursive-entry equation defining refPrime for integers at least two via refPrimeFrom.
Selection equation defining refChoose to return a new prime candidate when it exceeds the prior best.
definitions.text:
rule refChoose(N, BEST) => N
    requires refPrime(N) andBool N >Int BEST

definitions.rationale: Complementary selection equation defining refChoose to retain the prior best.
definitions.text:
rule refChoose(N, BEST) => BEST
    requires notBool (refPrime(N) andBool N >Int BEST)

definitions.rationale: Empty-list case defining refLargest to return zero.
Recursive equation defining refLargest from the integer head, recursively summarized tail, and refChoose.
definitions.text:
rule refLargest(VS) => refChoose(intHead(VS), refLargest(intTail(VS)))
    requires valLength(VS) =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Recursive decimal recurrence defining refDigitSum from the last digit and remaining prefix.
definitions.text:
rule refDigitSum(N) => N %Int 10 +Int refDigitSum(N /Int 10)
    requires N >=Int 10

definitions.rationale: Top-level equation defining refAnswer as the digit sum of refLargest.
